response_text: Col told you what? He must have been confused about the time. He was there — I can't help it if he got muddled.
Initials mean nothing — the belt could have been made for anyone with those letters. I told you I lost it.
Nadia's wrong and Col's muddled. You're building a case on two unreliable witnesses. I was at my yard.
You've got a belt in a bin, a nurse who saw a grey jacket, and a document that Marcus signed of his own free will. That's not a murder case. That's guesswork. I want a solicitor.

...He texted me the night before. Said to say I was there from quarter to seven if anyone asked. I turned up at half seven and there was no timber job. I shouldn't have agreed. I knew something was wrong when he sent that text.
